stories.title: People confined to homes amid leopard scare in Moradabad:Alert on Kanwar route; leopard mauls woman to death, leaves farmer critically injured
stories.summary: "Three days ago, a leopard mauled a woman to death and injured a farmer. On Thursday at 2 PM, two leopards were seen roaming around. Forest department employees were right there. Around 7:30 PM, a third leopard also arrived. All three leopards sat comfortably until 9 PM. If the forest department wanted, they could have easily caught them. Can't understand whether these forest department people are catching leopards in this 'Lalapur' or rearing them." These words were spoken by Mahipal Singh of Lalapur village in Moradabad. Actually, in the Thakurdwara area of Moradabad adjacent to the Uttarakhand border, which falls in the buffer zone of Jim Corbett, 3-4 leopards have been creating terror for the past 10 days. A population of about 1 lakh within a radius of approximately 20 km is living in fear. Being a Kanwar route, alert posters have been put up at various places. People have stopped going out alone or in pairs. Families are not sending children to school. To know in detail about the terror of the leopard- 50 employees of Forest Department are searching for leopards; 13 cages have been set up A team of more than 50 forest experts from the Forest Department has been called from 6 different districts. They have been tasked with catching the leopards. Thermal drones have been procured from Pilibhit Tiger Reserve to search for the leopards. Meanwhile, tranquilizing experts who have come from Agra are also keeping watch here. To catch the leopards, the Forest Department team has identified locations across the entire area and set up 13 cages. Arrangements are being made for 20 more cages. However, despite all these efforts, the Forest Department team has so far been unsuccessful in catching the leopards. See 2 pictures When daughter reached field; leopard was mauling and eating mother On Monday, 3rd August, in Lallapur Piplasana village of Surjan Nagar police station area in Thakurdwara, a leopard mauled a woman to death in a sugarcane field. Santosh Devi, wife of Virendra Saini from the village, had gone to the field on Monday morning to collect green fodder for the cattle. During this time, the leopard attacked her. Santosh's daughter Sheetal said that the forest department is unable to catch the leopard. After 8 PM, the forest department teams also leave with their vehicles. After his mother's death, police and administration officials only gave assurances to the family. They have promised ₹5 lakh compensation, a job for one family member, and to catch the leopard soon. Attacked farmer on third day after killing woman After taking the life of a woman in Lalapur Peeplasana village on Monday, the leopard attacked a farmer on Wednesday morning in the Dilari area about 10 km away. Farmer Babu was removing sugarcane leaves in the field around 7:45 am. During this time, a leopard that emerged from the bushes suddenly attacked him. Hearing Babu's screams, nearby villagers reached the spot. Seeing the crowd of people, the leopard fled towards the forest. The farmer was seriously injured in the attack. Villagers took him to the Community Health Center. After primary treatment, he was referred to the district hospital in Moradabad. Farmers say - How can we bring fodder from the fields Farmers said that now they are afraid to go to the fields. It has also become difficult to bring fodder for the cattle. Officers come during the day. They give assurances and leave. At night, leopards roam around the village and nearby areas. Another farmer said that the forest department team sets up chairs on the roads during the day and sits there, but as soon as night falls, they leave from there. Posters warning about leopards put up on Kanwar route Due to the Kanwar Yatra, Kanwariyas are also passing through the Thakurdwara area. Keeping this in view, the police and forest department have put up posters at various places on the Kanwar route. These appeal to passersby to be cautious of leopards and wild animals. Police patrolling has also been increased along the entire route. Due to fear of leopards, villagers are avoiding going to their fields. Many families have also stopped sending their children to school for now. DM-SSP reached the village and took information about leopard rescue DM Rajendra Pensiya and SSP Satpal Antil reached Lalapur Peeplasana village on Saturday evening. They held a meeting and talked with the villagers. They appealed for cooperation in the campaign to capture the leopard. The officials instructed the forest department team to capture the leopard soon. The villagers assured full cooperation in the campaign. After this, the DM and SSP also checked the forest department's tranquilizer gun.

stories.title: Yamuna swells in Mathura-Vrindavan, parikrama route flooded:Ghat steps submerged, temple flooded in Kanpur; rain alert in 52 cities
stories.summary: Continuous monsoon rain in Uttar Pradesh has caused rivers to swell. More than 10 rivers, including the Ganga, Yamuna, Sharda and Saryu, are flowing close to the danger mark. In Mathura, the Yamuna has reached the steps of the ghats. In Vrindavan, the parikrama route at Keshi Ghat is submerged, with devotees walking through around one foot of water to complete the circumambulation. At Brahmavart Ghat, around 25km from Kanpur city, the ‘Brahma Ki Khunti’ temple has been flooded, with the shrine’s pillar submerged. In Kashi, the Ganga has reached Manikarnika Ghat, while roads connecting all 84 ghats are waterlogged, cutting off their access to one another. The Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat has been shifted to another location. In Farrukhabad, 36 villages are affected by flooding. In Bijnor, the Ganga has been flowing over the state highway for the past 11 days, worsening the situation in 12 villages. Residents are being forced to leave their homes. Boats are being used in rural areas of both districts, while people are relying on tractors and bullock carts for travel. Since Sunday morning, most cities including Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi and Prayagraj have had clear weather with bright sunshine. Clouds are appearing intermittently, but cool winds have kept temperatures comfortable. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for 52 districts today. Heavy rainfall is possible in 10 districts, including Lalitpur and Sonbhadra. See the pictures of rain and flooding… Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said: The low-pressure area over south-western Uttar Pradesh has now weakened. The monsoon trough is extending from Delhi and Agra towards the east-central Bay of Bengal. Meanwhile, another low-pressure area over south Bengal and adjoining northern Odisha is moving north-westwards. As a result, the monsoon is likely to remain more active over southern parts of Uttar Pradesh for the next three days.

stories.title: 356 PG seats vacant in BHU:52 applications rejected, 304 students skip admission; full fee refund for those who didn’t enroll
stories.summary: The admission process for postgraduate (PG) courses at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) has been completed. A total of 356 seats remained vacant till the final stage of admission on the main campus as well as affiliated colleges. Of these, 52 candidates' applications were rejected due to incomplete applications or errors found in certificates, while 304 candidates did not take admission despite being allotted seats. According to the university, students left their seats due to several reasons such as not getting the desired subject or branch, getting admission in another center, and taking admission in an institution closer to home. BHU conducted the admission process for approximately 150 PG courses running across 13 faculties this year by dividing them into general and practical-based courses. The university completed the admission process in a phased manner. Four general admission rounds were conducted for 123 general courses, while two admission rounds were held for 27 practical-based courses. After this, two spot rounds were organized to fill vacant seats, and finally, a mop-up round was also conducted. Departmental reporting completed by 28 July After completion of all admission phases, the university administration completed the physical reporting of all selected candidates in departments by 28 July. Following this, classes for the new session were started from 30 July. During physical reporting, the number of candidates whose admission was cancelled for some reason or another, or who did not take admission in the allotted seat, came to light. These seats are now considered vacant. BHU Central Admission Committee Coordinator Prof. Bhaskar Bhattacharya informed that during various rounds of seat allotment, candidates are also given the opportunity to cancel their seats. If a candidate does not want to take admission on the allotted seat or leaves their seat, then in the next phase that seat is allotted to another eligible candidate. He explained that candidates may have different reasons for leaving seats. Sometimes, they don't get their desired subject or branch, while some candidates take admission in another center or institution. Meanwhile, some students give priority to admission in a university or college near their home. Maximum students from General category left their seats According to the data, out of 356 candidates who did not take admission in BHU, the highest number of 157 are from the General category. Apart from this, 52 candidates from the OBC category and 40 candidates from the SC category also did not take admission in the allotted seats. Meanwhile, 22-22 candidates each from the ST and EWS categories left their seats. 15 candidates from the Divyang (Disabled) category also did not take admission. Apart from this, the remaining candidates belong to various other quotas and categories implemented in the university, including BHU Ward. The university administration had made arrangements to allot vacant seats to eligible candidates in the next round at all stages of the admission process. Full amount will be refunded if admission is not taken after depositing fees There is also a provision for fee refund under BHU's admission rules. Those candidates who had deposited fees during the admission process, but later did not take admission on the allotted seat for some reason, will be refunded the full fee as per rules. According to the university administration, the fee refund process for candidates who vacate seats will be initiated after the completion of the PG admission process for the current academic session. This means that students who deposited fees but did not take admission in BHU will have a clear path to get their entire deposited fee refunded as per rules.

Therefore, when Ahjam arrived at the cemetery with his brother's body, the crowd became uncontrollable. During this, a policeman pushed back the crowd by hitting them with a gun butt. Even after this, when some youths insisted on going inside, the police slapped them and removed them. After this, the crowd dispersed from there. However, people continued to create a commotion.

stories.title: Man accused of raping, killing girl dies in encounter:₹50,000 bounty on him; 2 cops, including sub-inspector, injured
stories.summary: The accused in a 12-year-old girl’s rape and murder was killed in a police encounter in Bulandshahr. ADG Bhanu Pratap had announced a ₹50,000 reward for information on him just 24 hours earlier. According to police, the accused allegedly abducted the girl from outside her home, raped and killed her. He then attacked her face, shoulders, hands, stomach, chest and legs before leaving her semi-naked body in bushes and fleeing. Police had been searching for accused Monu since 1st August. CCTV footage showed him taking the girl away. At around 4 am on Sunday, police stopped him, but he allegedly opened fire. He was killed in retaliatory firing. A sub-inspector and constable were also shot and injured. Two inspectors survived after bullets hit their bulletproof jackets. The encounter took place in the Gulawathi police station area, around 40km from the district headquarters. Two pictures from the encounter site: Police stopped him, and he opened fire, killed in retaliatory firing SSP Dinesh Kumar Singh said the SWAT team and local police were conducting checks early on Sunday when they tried to stop suspects riding a motorcycle without a number plate. The suspects allegedly opened fire at the police. Monu was hit in the retaliatory firing. Police took him to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. One of his associates escaped in the darkness during the encounter, and police are conducting a search operation to find him. He said SOG sub-inspector Sandeep Kumar and constable Narendra Kumar were shot in the hand during the firing. Bulandshahr’s Sikandrabad inspector Shailendra Kumar and Gulawathi inspector Dharmendra Sharma were hit by bullets on their bulletproof jackets, which saved their lives. Police recovered a pistol, two magazines, cartridges and a motorcycle without a number plate from the encounter site. Girl’s body found 2km from her home The student, who lived in the Kakod police station area, was studying in Class 4. At around 3 pm on 1st August, she left home for some work but did not return. When the girl failed to come home, her family became worried and searched for her in every possible place. At around 8 pm, villagers spotted the girl’s body in bushes near Vair railway station, about 2km from her home. They informed the police, and the family arrived shortly afterwards and identified the body as that of the missing student. The girl was found without clothes and had serious injury marks on her face. Three pictures related to the girl’s murder: Accused Monu was identified through CCTV footage Following the incident, SP Dinesh Kumar and MLA Lakshmi Raj Singh visited the spot. They met the victim’s family, offered their condolences and assured them that the accused would be arrested as soon as possible. SP Dinesh Kumar formed police teams to track down the accused. Police examined CCTV footage from cameras installed around the area where the girl’s body was found. The footage showed the accused taking the girl away, which helped police identify him as Monu.

stories.title: Will Atiq’s sons ever get out of jail?:English-educated, then jailed for extortion; what next for Shaista and her sons?
stories.summary: When mafia don Atiq was alive, he called his son Asad his successor. People of Prayagraj started calling Asad 'Saansadji' (Member of Parliament). He was killed in a police encounter. Atiq loved his younger son Abaan the most. A few months ago, Abaan had posted a reel on social media. In it, he was saying, 'We don't attack from behind like dogs.' On 6th August, Abaan died in a road accident. Among Atiq's surviving sons, 2 are imprisoned in Lucknow and Jhansi jails. One son, Ahzam, lives at his aunt's house in Prayagraj. In today's Sunday Big Story, let's understand how Atiq turned his sons into goons as well... First, let's know about those who remain in the family The eldest son, Umar, had no interest in politics. He was good at studies from the beginning, so he went to Uttarakhand to study law. He keeps a moustache like Atiq. He is currently imprisoned in Lucknow jail. The allegation is that in 2018, at Atiq's behest, Umar kidnapped Lucknow real estate businessman Mohit Jaiswal. He took him to Deoria jail. Atiq was imprisoned in the same jail. With the connivance of the jail administration, Mohit was taken to Atiq Ahmed's barrack number-7. There he was brutally beaten, and property worth ₹45 crores was forcibly transferred. The CBI is investigating the case. On 23rd August, 2022, Umar surrendered. He has been imprisoned since then. Umar is also accused of conspiring in the Umesh Pal murder case. If proven, he could also get life imprisonment. Son Ali Ahmed is accused of demanding extortion of ₹5 crore from his relative Zeeshan alias Janu and a life-threatening attack. He is an accused conspirator in the Umesh Pal murder case. Apart from this, about 11 cases, including attempt to murder, Gangster Act, are registered. He is currently lodged in Jhansi jail. On 1st October, 2025, while being shifted from Naini jail to Jhansi, he told the media, 'I am being harassed otherwise, Chief Minister, please save me. I was studying while living in Delhi; they filed a false case and sent me to jail.' Charges have been framed in the cases registered against Ali. Testimony is ongoing. He could get life imprisonment. There is no case against Ahzam so far. He came to Jhansi to collect his brother's body after his death, when his picture appeared in the media for the first time. He had said at that time - Let my brothers participate in the funeral. Ahzam is not active on social media either. After passing 12th grade in 2024, he is studying at a college in Prayagraj. He lives at his aunt Parveen Qureshi's house in Hatwa village of the district. Atiq's wife Shaista Parveen has 7 cases registered against her. She is accused of conspiracy in the Umesh Pal murder case and providing shelter to the shooters. The ED has registered a case of fraud and extortion. After the charges are proven in that case, she could face life imprisonment. However, this is only possible if Shaista is caught. Shaista has been searched for by UP Police, STF and ATS in 9 states of the country. On 19 April, 2023, information was received about her being in Palhana village of Kaushambi district, but nothing was found. In between, inputs were received that Shaista had fled to Dubai. However, the administration has not confirmed this so far. Meanwhile, Ashraf's wife Zainab and Atiq's sister Ayesha Noori are also absconding. There is a reward of ₹25,000 on both of them. When political influence decreased, Atiq pushed his son forward Atiq married Shaista Parveen in 1996. By 2008, he had 5 sons - Umar, Ali, Asad, Ahzam and Abaan. Atiq educated all of them at the city's renowned English medium St. Joseph School. He would also take them along to political programs. He would not hesitate to threaten and beat people even in front of the children. The effect of this was that the sons also started following in Atiq's footsteps. Atiq's third son, Asad, was the most prominent in this regard. Atiq remained an MP until 2009. After that, his political stature began to decline. He lost his first election in 2012, and then could never become 'Honorable' again. He lost 4 elections by 2019. In the last election in 2019, when he contested against PM Modi, he received only 855 votes. At that time, he was in jail. After this, Atiq started pushing his children forward. When Atiq went to jail in 2017, it began to be said that Asad was taking over his political legacy. Asad used to say from political platforms, 'The bars of jail don't have the strength to stop the steel of our courage. Whenever we wish, we will break the chains and see the sight of the open sky.' Atiq and Asad were killed, two sons went to jail 2023 was the beginning of destruction for the Atiq clan. Son Asad fired indiscriminately at Umesh Pal, the main witness in the Raju Pal murder case, on 24 February and absconded. After this, CM Yogi had said in the assembly, 'We will crush this mafia into dust.' Then began the bulldozer action, which continues till date. During this time, Atiq, who was imprisoned in Sabarmati Jail, was being brought to Prayagraj on 12 April. When the police convoy stopped for a while in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, he pleaded from inside the van to the media - 'The government had said they would crush me into dust, so we have been crushed into dust... now we are just being ground down. I would like to tell the government not to harass the women and children at home.' The next day after this statement, on 13 April, 2023, the police killed Asad in an encounter in Jhansi. Exactly 2 days later, on 15 April, Atiq Ahmed and his brother Ashraf were killed by 3 boys in Prayagraj while in police custody. When Atiq's wife Shaista and Ashraf's wife Zainab's names also came up in the Umesh Pal murder case, both had absconded. Ali and Umar are also involved in this case. The fourth and fifth sons were minors at that time. Both were kept in a juvenile home. Later, they were handed over to Atiq's sister Parveen. Now the youngest son Abaan has died in an accident. Atiq had built a large economic empire through crime. The administration has so far seized assets worth more than ₹3,000 crore. Investigation officers claim that Atiq's benami properties are worth more than ₹10,000 crore.

stories.title: Woman accusing BJP MLA of misconduct shows evidence:‘Why did he get a ‘pass’ put on my car?’; recommended halving her fees
stories.summary: A BJP MLA from Sultanpur Sadar, Vinod Singh, has been accused of attempting rape. The MLA clarified that he doesn't even know the woman. The woman claimed that the MLA is lying. While talking to Dainik Bhaskar, she showed such evidence that indicates that the MLA knew the woman. A case has already been registered against the BJP MLA in Delhi. Before this, the MLA had registered a case of attempted fraud against the woman and her husband in Lucknow. The MLA alleges that the woman's husband had introduced his brother as an IAS officer. To understand this high-profile case, we spoke to the woman. She said- I lived on the 7th floor; MLA lived on the 4th floor We asked the woman- How did you come in contact with the MLA? Had the MLA ever done such a thing before? She says- The MLA is from our area only. My house is about 2 km away from his house. My in-laws' place is also nearby. I have known him for a long time, but our acquaintance had grown more in the last 2 years. When he got his daughter married, he had specially invited us. After that, whenever there was something at home, he would send sweets. We also went to his Lucknow flat 2-3 times, but my husband was with me then. For the past nearly 1 year, I have been living with my family in a rented apartment located in Hazratganj, Lucknow. I was living on the 7th floor, while MLA Vinod Singh lives on the fourth floor. Sometimes we would meet in the lift. Then he would say-You are very daring; I like a girl like you. The woman also showed our team 2 papers. She said that if I am a stranger to the MLA, then why did he recommend on his letterhead last year to get my PhD fees reduced by half? She alleges that the MLA did all this to impress me. At that time, I couldn't understand why he was doing this. But when he did all this with me, then I understood what he wanted. Now I want action to be taken against him. June 3 - When rape was attempted Touched inappropriately while intoxicated, threatened upon resistance The woman says, ''On June 3, 2026, I was at my flat with my daughter. Around 10:30 pm, the MLA's gunner, Dhananjay Yadav, came to our flat. He said that the MLA is calling you. He needs to discuss a matter. He has a meeting in Delhi tomorrow. I replied - My husband is not here; I won't be able to come. He said there's no problem; you please come. Then I went with him to the MLA's flat. Dhananjay stopped outside the gate; I went inside. The MLA was sitting in the room drinking alcohol. At that time, he was intoxicated. He said that after seeing you, I don't understand what to do? You are not understanding my feelings. After this, he got up and started trying to hug me. He touched the wrong place, so I immediately pushed him away. I said that all this doesn't suit you; you are like a father. But, he kept talking nonsense in his intoxicated state. I left there crying and went to my flat.'' Why did she complain to the police so late Husband explained- He is powerful, yet I went to the police station We asked- Why didn't you go to the police at that time? The woman said- My husband explained to me that he is a BJP MLA. He is currently in the government. Police and everything is in his hands. It's better not to take this matter forward. At that time, I agreed with him. The next day, I went to Hazratganj police station and gave a complaint to Station In-charge Vikram Singh. He said, You go; we will look into it. But, no case was registered. The woman says- I left that flat the same day. After 2-3 days, calls started coming from the MLA's side. His gunman, Dhananjay, called me and threatened me. Dhananjay said that whatever sir wants has to be done. Otherwise, acid could be thrown on your daughter and other things could happen too. Hearing this, I got scared. My 10-year-old daughter is also going through mental stress. She has stopped going to school. She asks, Mummy, will these people throw acid? Then I decided that action must be taken. After complaint to Women's Commission; MLA got a case filed We were being searched for in UP. Their relatives are in SOG. They were giving our location to their people. These people were following us. On 10 July, we filed a complaint with the Women's Commission in Delhi. The Women's Commission sought a response from UP Police. Around 11:30 PM, MLA Vinod Singh filed a case against me and my husband at Hazratganj police station. At that time, we didn't even know about this case because the police hadn't even put it online. To get a copy of the case, we had to go to CGM Court. The MLA's allegation is that her husband tried to defraud them by claiming his brother was an IAS officer. That's why he filed the case. To this, she says, ''My husband is the only child. He doesn't have any brother. The MLA has known our family for a very long time. He has so much power; then why would he get work done through any common person? What need did he have to contact anyone to get an FCI warehouse? He himself has access up to Amit Shah. He can get whatever he wants done. MLA's response- Allegations made to escape fraud case Regarding these allegations, MLA Vinod Singh had said on 4 August that the woman's husband had committed fraud with him. Due to this, he had filed a case against the woman and her husband. The MLA claims that such allegations are being made against him to escape from this case. After talking to the victim, we tried to ask MLA Vinod Singh 2 questions- First- If the fraud with you happened earlier, then why did you file the case on 10 July? Was the decision to file the case taken after the complaint to the Women's Commission? Second- Why did you recommend waiving the woman's fees? What was the reason for giving the MLA pass to put on the vehicle? Despite calling several times, contact could not be established with MLA Vinod Singh.

stories.summary: Atiq Ahmed's youngest 21-year-old son Abaan was laid to rest on 8 August in Prayagraj. In Prayagraj, his two elder brothers Ali and Omar, who were imprisoned, also attended the funeral on parole. When Atiq's three sons Umar, Ali and Ahzam met together after 4 years, they cried profusely with hands on each other's shoulders. Their tears were flowing in the grief of laying Abaan to rest, but when they reached their father Atiq's grave buried next to Abaan, they placed their heads on it and kept crying for a long time. In April 2023, their father and uncle Ashraf were shot dead while under police protection. Even then, Umar and Ali were in jail. Their brother Asad, who was killed in an encounter, is also buried next to Atiq. After their father, they also cried profusely, placing their foreheads on the graves of both Asad and Ashraf. Crying, all three clung to each other. At that moment, tears also welled up in the eyes of the crowd gathered near the graves. People began reciting Quranic verses rapidly. Then an announcement was made to recite Fateha, so that their sobbing would stop. After burying Abaan, Umar-Ali talked to his brother Ahzam and aunt for an hour. Everyone kept crying for an hour. He said to his aunt - What has happened to all this? Read what happened at Abaan's funeral... For half-an-hour, Umar-Ali sat in the van gazing at each other's vehicles Amidst preparations for burial at Kasari-Masari cemetery, Umar, imprisoned in Lucknow jail, arrived first on Saturday at 4:34 PM with 6 police vehicles. The funeral procession had not arrived yet, so Umar was kept seated in the van. Until then, the crowd remained standing surrounding Umar's van. During this time, entry at the gate had been stopped. The crowd became uncontrollable and broke through the barricading for the first time and entered inside. About half an hour later, at 5:05 PM, Ali's van arrived from Jhansi jail with security of 6 vehicles. Ali's van was parked behind Umar's van. Meanwhile, both brothers just kept looking at each other's vans. Ahzam reached the cemetery crying; 2 boys kept supporting him At 5:51 PM, Ahzam entered the cemetery with a large crowd ahead of Abaan's funeral procession. Ahzam was crying and unable to walk. 2 boys took him inside, supporting him with hands on his shoulder and waist. When the crowd with Ahzam moved forward to see Ali and Umar after 4 years, the police stopped them. This caused a commotion there. Once again, the barricading was broken. After this, the police chased the crowd, wielded lathis, slapped, and hit with rifle butts. Meanwhile, Ahzam reached directly near Ali's van. Both placed their hands on the van's window and tried to touch each other's hands. During this, Ahzam also kept wiping his tears with a towel. Like their father, Ali-Umar were seen wearing turbans-handkerchiefs and carrying towels At 6:13 PM, Ali was brought out of the van. At the same time, Umar was brought down from the second van. When the two brothers came face to face amidst security, they hugged each other. Ali was wearing a black kurta. Like his father Atiq, he had tied a large handkerchief on his head and had a white towel on his shoulder. His elder brother Umar had tied a white turban on his head. Wearing a white kurta, Umar clung to Ali. Atiq was also fond of tying a handkerchief on his head and tying a white gamchha like a turban. Umar-Ali in front, and Ahzam, aunt's son, carried the bier from behind After this, Ahzam reached both brothers, Umar-Ali. All three embraced each other. Taking Umar and Ali along, he went towards Abaan's funeral procession. By then, the funeral bier was placed on the ground. The carrying of the funeral bier begins with close family members. In this manner, Umar and Ali held the front two legs, Ahzam held the back leg, and the aunt's son held the fourth leg. After this, the funeral bier was carried on shoulders to the place beside the mosque where a crowd had gathered for the funeral prayer. Then after the funeral prayer, Abaan was laid to rest. Chased away, lathi-charged, but the crowd stood firm After Abaan's death in a road accident, sympathy for the Atiq family openly came to the fore on Saturday. Firstly, after 4 years, Atiq's sons Ali and Umar came to Kasari-Masari. In this, Ahzam was also publicly present among the crowd. In such a situation, the crowd appeared eager to reach inside the cemetery from all sides. When entry was not allowed from the main gate, people broke the boundary of the cemetery from the back side and entered inside. Everyone wanted to participate in the funeral as well as get close to Umar, Ali, and Ahzam. Those who came to the cemetery were fine. Apart from that, there were several thousand people who were not allowed entry. Such people stood forming a circle around the cemetery. From afternoon till 8 pm, until Ali-Umar's van left, the crowd kept staring at the cemetery. In such a situation, the police had to lathi-charge the uncontrollable crowd several times, but the crowd of youth kept running here and there. Actually, 2 days before the murder of Atiq and Ashraf, on 13 April, 2023, Asad was killed in an encounter in Jhansi. A crowd had gathered to carry Asad's body, but they had to return due to strict police action. Then a crowd had gathered for Atiq-Ashraf's funeral, but barricading was done throughout the western city, and everyone was stopped. After the pain of 3 deaths, now everyone wanted to reach the cemetery for Abaan's death. Not the Imam, Umar led the funeral prayer for his brother There were many Maulanas and Maulvis at Kasari-Masari cemetery. The chief Imam of the mosque there was also present. Despite this, elder brother Umar led the funeral prayer (Janaza) for Abaan. This was the most talked-about matter. Actually, after going to jail, Umar had grown a beard. He keeps reciting the Holy Quran throughout the day. He reads religious books. That's why he himself asked to lead the prayer. Umar explained to Ahzam, don't come to meet in jail repeatedly After placing soil on Abaan's grave, the three brothers recited Fateha. Then they reached the tent set up adjacent to the mosque, 100 steps away. There, Aunt Parveen Qureshi was sitting in a wheelchair. Upon seeing them, they rushed forward; first, Umar hugged her. The aunt kissed his forehead. Then Ali also clung to her and started crying. He said - Aunt, what has happened? The aunt also hugged both of them and started crying. After wiping each other's tears, they talked for about an hour. The aunt said - What has Allah done? What days are we seeing? Ali said - Don't worry, Inshallah everything will be fine. After this, they started asking about family members. Most of the conversation was about mother Shaista Parveen and aunt Zainab. They talked about close relatives who are in jail. Umar also explained that Ahzam doesn't need to come to jail repeatedly now. Both expressed concern that one brother is outside; he should stay well and take care of everyone. There was also discussion about bail.

stories.title: Lover hacks girlfriend’s husband with 17 strikes:Came to take wife home, accused attacked him with blade
stories.summary: In Muzaffarnagar, on Saturday at 7 am, a lover hacked his girlfriend's husband to death with a chopper. The accused attacked the young man 17 times with a chopper in 16 seconds. After that, he fled from the scene. Nearby people informed the wife about the incident. With the help of people, the wife took her husband to the hospital. Due to his critical condition, doctors referred him to Meerut, where he died during treatment. The incident took place in the Budhana area. Police investigation revealed that the husband had come to his in-laws' house to pick up his wife. The deceased was a resident of Meerut. He had come to his in-laws' house in Nai Basti, Budhana, on August 4. He used to work in Surat. He was also going to take his wife to Surat. It was over this matter that he argued with his wife's lover. Watch 3 footages of the attack Lover seen roaming with a chopper in hand A video related to this incident has also surfaced. In which it can be seen, the lover is seen roaming in the street with a chopper in his hand. The husband is also seen coming behind him. After this, the lover runs towards the husband. A fight breaks out between the two. During the fight, the husband falls into a drain. After this, the lover continuously attacks the husband with the chopper. Wife's Affair After Marriage According to the police, Talib was married to Meena, a resident of Nai Basti in Budhana, 7 years ago. They also have two children. Talib was a resident of Meerut. After marriage, he started living with his wife in a rented room in Budhana. He worked in Surat. He used to visit Budhana occasionally. Meanwhile, Meena had an affair with Hashim, who lived in Nai Basti. Hashim used to frequent Meena's house. Talib became aware of this. Since then, there have been several disputes between Talib and Hashim. Talib also started living in Budhana for most of the time. He used to go to Surat sometimes. When Talib came to Budhana on August 4, he asked his wife Meena to come to Surat as well. Meena told this to her lover. Hashim did not want Meena to go to Surat because of this, Hashim and Talib started arguing on the morning of August 8. After this, Hashim murdered Talib. Accused will be arrested soon, says Budhana Town In-charge Budhana Town In-charge Lalit Kasana stated that in the preliminary investigation, the reason for the murder has been revealed to be an illicit relationship. There was a dispute between the husband and the lover over this matter. People from the vicinity have been interrogated. Police teams have been formed for the arrest of the accused. Raids are being conducted at possible hideouts.

stories.title: Man tied up and beaten for meeting married girlfriend:Thrashed with sticks, women hit him with slippers; girlfriend also beaten
stories.summary: In Kanpur Dehat, a lover who went to meet his married girlfriend was severely beaten by people. First, he was tied with a rope and beaten, then laid on the ground and hit 20-25 times with a stick on his soles. The women of the house hit him with slippers. The girlfriend, who came to save her lover, was also beaten. The incident took place on Friday morning in Khirwan Dera village, Derapur police station area, about 25 km from the district headquarters. The young man had arrived late on Thursday night to meet her. When the neighbours found out, they locked the house from outside in the morning. A video of the lover and his married girlfriend being beaten has also surfaced. On the information of the villagers, the police arrested the lover. See pictures Know the full story... Pawan (25), a resident of Khirwan Dera village, works as a labourer. He belongs to the Banjara community. On Thursday night, he went to meet a married woman from the village at her house. In the morning, when neighbours found out, they latched the door from the outside. The frightened woman hid Pawan in the wardrobe of the room. The woman's in-laws had gone to work in the fields. Upon returning home, they started searching for the young man, but he was not found. After searching for about three hours, they opened the wardrobe and found Pawan hidden inside. The in-laws pulled Pawan out and severely beat him. After that, they tied his hands and feet with a rope in the courtyard. He was made to lie on the ground and beaten on the soles of his feet with sticks. The women of the house also hit him with slippers. When the woman tried to save Pawan, her in-laws also assaulted her. After beating him for a long time, the in-laws handed the young man over to the police. The police took him to the station and conducted a medical examination. After this, he was challaned for disturbing the peace and released. Love marriage six years ago The woman had a love marriage about six years ago with Shankar, who lives in the same village. She has two children. It is being reported that for the past two months, the woman's closeness with Pawan had increased. Both are from the Banjara community.

On Saturday at 9 am, there was a dispute between the two over some matter. It escalated so much that it led to physical violence. The husband brought a knife from the kitchen in anger. He attacked his wife repeatedly. The wife fell to the ground covered in blood. When people nearby heard the screams and arrived, the husband had already fled. Police who arrived after being informed took the woman to a nearby hospital. There, doctors declared Shalini Yadav (29) dead. The incident occurred in the Nasirpir locality of the Kotwali area. Police are searching for the accused husband, Dilip Kumar Yadav. Husband and wife lived in a rented house The accused husband Dilip Yadav is an assistant teacher at the primary school in Chak Alipur. He lives in a rented house in the Nasirpir area. On Saturday, he did not go to school. Shailini's father, Dharam Singh Yadav, who reached the spot, said, "My son-in-law Dilip has murdered my daughter. The son-in-law was having an affair with another woman. They used to quarrel over this matter.''

stories.title: BJP announces new regional morcha in-charges:Ramesh Singh gets Kashi, Abhijat assigned Gorakhpur; Priyanka named ST Morcha vice-president
stories.summary: Ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the BJP is strengthening its organisational team with a fresh round of appointments. The party today (8 Aug) announced six new regional in-charges and seven front in-charges, assigning them responsibilities for the upcoming Assembly and Panchayat elections. State vice-president Ramesh Singh has been appointed in-charge of the Kashi region, associated with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while state general secretary Abhijat Mishra will oversee the Gorakhpur region, the political base of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. State general secretary Dilip Patel has been given charge of the Awadh region, while state general secretary Ram Pratap Singh Chauhan will oversee the Western region. Geeta Shakya has been appointed in-charge of Braj, while Shankar Lodhi will handle Kanpur. Seven leaders assigned charge of party fronts State general secretary Rajesh Chaudhary has been appointed in-charge of the Youth Front, while state general secretary Sanjay Rai will oversee the Backward Classes Front. State vice-president Kameshwar Singh has been given charge of the Women’s Front, while state vice-president Dharmendra Singh will handle the Scheduled Caste Front. BJP state vice-president Priyanka Rawat has been appointed in-charge of the Scheduled Tribe Front, Shankar Giri will oversee the Farmers’ Front and Devesh Kori will handle the Minority Front. Govind Shukla gets charge of BJP headquarters Former state general secretary and MLC Govind Narayan Shukla has been appointed in-charge of the BJP state headquarters. He is the only former office-bearer to have been given responsibility at the state headquarters. His long experience in managing election campaigns, particularly during Assembly polls, is believed to have led to his appointment. Yatendra Sharma to oversee media department State minister Yatendra Sharma has been appointed in-charge of the BJP’s media department. Earlier, Manish Dixit was appointed as the department’s convener, while Devendra Pratap Singh was made the party’s chief spokesperson. Complete list of BJP's newly appointed office-bearers… Ramesh Singh gets bigger role despite no previous stint in state team The BJP has elevated state vice-president Ramesh Singh by appointing him in-charge of the Kashi region. Singh is considered close to a regional RSS functionary. The responsibility of regional in-charge is generally assigned to state general secretaries, making Singh’s appointment notable as he is a state vice-president. Despite holding a key organisational post now, Singh had not previously been part of the BJP’s state team. Regional in-charges to play key role in candidate selection The BJP has appointed one in-charge for each of Uttar Pradesh’s six regions to oversee organisational activities, campaigns and preparations for the upcoming Assembly elections. Regional in-charges are expected to play an important role in the selection of Assembly candidates. Their views are considered when panels of prospective candidates are discussed before the party finalises its nominees.

stories.title: Drone flies near Yogi’s stage, triggering police alert:Youth detained, probe underway; CM showers flowers on Kanwariyas in Meerut
stories.summary: A suspected drone was spotted near the stage where Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was attending an event in Meerut on Saturday, triggering a security alert. Police immediately seized the drone and detained the man who was allegedly operating it. Meerut SSP Avinash Pandey said the man claimed he was unaware of the rules governing drone operations. Police are checking his social media profiles and examining the footage recorded by the drone. Further action will be taken after a forensic examination, the SSP said. CM showers flowers on Kanwariyas Earlier, at around 12.30 pm, Adityanath showered flowers on Kanwariyas in Meerut. Standing on the stage, the Chief Minister showered petals on Shiva devotees carrying Kanwars as they moved forward chanting “Bol Bam” and “Har Har Mahadev”. Flowers were also showered from a helicopter during the event. The Kanwar Yatra has drawn large crowds across Uttar Pradesh during the month of Sawan. A large number of devotees have been seen on major Kanwar routes, including the Delhi-Dehradun Highway, since morning. Devotees carrying Kanwars and holy Ganga water have continued their journey towards their destinations. 70-year-old man cycles 100 km daily Among the pilgrims is 70-year-old Pramod Kumar from Delhi, who is carrying a Kanwar on his bicycle. Kumar said he had been travelling to Haridwar by bicycle to collect Ganga water for the past 10 years. He cycles around 100 km every day during the journey. In Muzaffarnagar, a Shiva devotee was seen undertaking the journey while wearing a blindfold. Ankit from Sonipat reached Shamli carrying a Kanwar decorated with 10 pigeons. 'Kanwar Yatra symbolises social and national unity' Adityanath welcomed the devotees taking part in the Kanwar Yatra and said the state government was fully prepared to ensure their safety and provide them with a warm welcome. He said devotees undertaking the journey on foot out of their faith in Lord Shiva represented devotion, dedication, social unity, social equality and national unity. The Chief Minister said the pilgrims were travelling beyond state boundaries and creating an atmosphere of enthusiasm and celebration. He added that flowers would continue to be showered on Kanwariyas for the next two days. Devotees from several states join the yatra Adityanath said a large crowd had gathered at Shiv Chowk in Muzaffarnagar and that he had the opportunity to shower flowers on devotees in Meerut. He said millions of Kanwariyas from Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, Punjab and Himachal Pradesh, along with devotees from western Uttar Pradesh, were participating in the pilgrimage. Major religious sites along the route include Baba Augharnath Temple in Meerut, Baba Dudheshwar Nath Temple in Ghaziabad and Pura Mahadev Temple in Baghpat. Police continue drone investigation Police said a government-operated drone and another drone were flying during the Chief Minister's programme. The operator of the second drone was detained immediately. The man, who is from the Medical police station area, told police that he was unaware of the rules regarding drone operations. Police are examining his social media activity and the footage recorded by the drone. Further legal action will follow the forensic examination.

stories.title: Mayawati targets SP over PDA:Says it once meant backwards, now means Pandit; calls it opportunistic politics
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party's national president Mayawati took a dig at SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. She said that Akhilesh, who earlier stated that the first 'P' in PDA meant 'Pichda' (backwards), is now interpreting 'P' as 'Pandit' (Brahmin) due to political self-interest. This is political opportunism. SP had organised a Brahmin conference on August 5, the birth anniversary of Janeshwar Mishra. In this, it had stated that the 'P' in 'PDA' meant 'Brahmin' and 'Peedit' (oppressed). BSP is also focusing on connecting Brahmins with the party this time. It has also declared several Brahmin candidates. The state has a Brahmin population of over 12 per cent. They have a decisive impact on more than 100 seats. This is why, before the elections, every party is organising various events to bring Brahmins into their fold. 'Earlier it was backward, now it's Pandit' BSP chief Mayawati, taking a dig on Saturday, said that SP had so far explained 'PDA' to mean Pichda (Backwards), Dalit, Alpasankhyak (Minority). But now, when the upper-caste society, especially the Brahmin community, is rapidly joining the BSP and the BSP is also giving them tickets, the SP has become nervous. For this reason, 'P' has now been changed to 'Pandit'. She said, "This is a living proof of their political deceit and trickery." 'BSP is for everyone, SP is narrowly casteist' Mayawati said that BSP is an Ambedkarite party that operates on the principle of 'Sarvajan Hitay, Sarvajan Sukhay' (for the welfare of all, for the happiness of all). On this basis, the BSP government ran four times in UP. On the other hand, SP changes colours like a chameleon for its narrow casteist politics and electoral self-interest. She said that such politics might benefit an individual for some time, but it cannot benefit the entire society. Therefore, people from all sections of society need to be cautious of SP's deceptive politics. This is both the demand of the time and in the interest of all sections of society.

stories.title: Flowers showered on those who threw slippers at Pappu Yadav:Roadshow held in open jeep, ‘Jai Shri Ram’ slogans raised
stories.summary: The two men accused of attacking Bihar MP Pappu Yadav with slippers were given a grand welcome in Bulandshahr on Friday (7 Aug) after being released on bail. Supporters garlanded the duo before they travelled in an open jeep in a 7-km roadshow from Bulandshahr to Nathla Hasanpur village. Supporters showered flowers during roadshow As the open jeep moved through the route, supporters showered the two men with flowers and raised slogans of 'Jai Shri Ram'. They later reached their village, where drums and trumpets were played during their welcome. Despite the rain, a large number of supporters were seen dancing and raising slogans. BJP district president Vikas Chauhan and several party workers also welcomed the duo, while their family members embraced them. Slipper attack followed protests over Pappu Yadav's Parliament remarks The incident came days after Pappu Yadav allegedly staged a 'chanda chori' demonstration in Parliament while dressed as a sadhu on July 31. Protests were subsequently held against him in several cities, including Lucknow. A Hindu nationalist leader had also announced a reward of ₹51 lakh for anyone who beheaded the MP. Both accused handed over to police after attack On August 2, Sumit Giri, a Bulandshahr resident, allegedly attacked Pappu Yadav along with his associate Happy Sharma. During the incident, Yadav reportedly caught Sumit, while his supporters allegedly assaulted Happy. Both men were subsequently handed over to the police. Sumit Giri is the BJP city minister, while Happy Sharma is the party's Mandal general secretary. See 3 pictures ‘Pappu Yadav was enraged when questioned over remarks on Sanatan Dharma’ Sumit Giri and his associate Happy Sharma alleged that Pappu Yadav became angry when they questioned him over remarks they considered insulting to Lord Shri Ram, worshipped by millions of Hindus. They further alleged that Yadav and his associates assaulted them. Sumit later lodged a complaint at Tilak Nagar Police Station in Delhi, accusing Yadav and his associates of assault and alleging that his gold chain and watch were taken during the incident. Mother broke down after BJP leader’s arrest Following Sumit Giri’s arrest, his mother broke down while speaking about her son. She said she only wanted him to return home safely and had no interest in politics. According to her, Sumit had left home saying he was going to his office. In an emotional appeal, she urged that her son be released and allowed to return home safely. First, know about the accused Sumit-Happy: Now see the pictures of the attack on the MP July 31: Pappu Yadav stages symbolic Ram Temple donation protest in Parliament On July 31, the 10th day of the Monsoon Session, Pappu Yadav arrived at Parliament dressed as a sadhu in saffron robes and carrying a donation box. He staged a short symbolic play on the Parliament premises to protest what he described as the alleged misuse or theft of Ram Temple donations. Pappu Yadav played the role of a priest and sat on the ground with the donation box. Rahul Gandhi and several other MPs then symbolically gave him donations. ‘Caught stealing’, opposition MPs stage symbolic action During the performance, Pappu Yadav was shown keeping the donated money with himself instead of putting it into the box. Opposition MPs, including Ayodhya MP Awadhesh Prasad, then staged a symbolic assault after allegedly catching him ‘stealing’ the donations. As part of the protest, Pappu Yadav was also seen touching Awadhesh Prasad’s feet. See pictures of the protest in the Parliament premises- Many opposition MPs put donations in the donation box. August 1: FIR registered against Rahul Gandhi, Awadhesh Prasad and Pappu Yadav An FIR was registered in Varanasi against Congress MP Rahul Gandhi, Samajwadi Party MP Awadhesh Prasad and Independent Bihar MP Pappu Yadav over their symbolic act in Parliament involving alleged theft of offerings. The complaint was filed by Jagadguru Balak Das, head priest of Patalpuri Math, at Kotwali Police Station. Meanwhile, in Lucknow, Anurodh Rai, national president of the Sanatan Raksha Sangathan, issued a warning against Pappu Yadav and alleged that Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav were also opposed to Sanatan Dharma. He demanded an apology and made a controversial threat against the leaders. He also announced a ₹51 lakh reward for anyone who beheads Pappu Yadav. August 2: Hindu groups protest outside Pappu Yadav’s wife’s residence Bajrang Dal workers and sadhus staged a protest outside the Delhi residence of Ranjeet Ranjan, Pappu Yadav’s wife and a Rajya Sabha MP. Reacting to the protest, Pappu Yadav warned that targeting his children or family members would escalate the matter. He said political or personal disputes should not involve children and family members. August 5: BJP leaders lodge complaint against Pappu Yadav Sumit Giri filed a complaint against Pappu Yadav at Tilak Marg Police Station, accusing him of assault, robbery and issuing death threats. In his complaint, Sumit alleged that if he or his associate Happy Sharma suffered any harm or an untoward incident in the future because of the alleged threats, Pappu Yadav, Munazir Alam and their associates should be held responsible.

stories.title: Ganga rises in Kashi, 84 ghats cut off:Water level rising 2 cm every hour, Manikarnika Ghat shrinks; monsoon reaches south UP
stories.summary: The water level of the Ganga in Kashi is continuously rising. This has broken the connection between the 84 ghats. The space available for cremation at Manikarnika Ghat is also continuously decreasing. The steps of many ghats have been submerged in water. This is making it difficult to go from one ghat to another. Although the flood situation in the city is not severe yet, the continuously rising water level is increasing the administration's concern. According to the Central Water Commission, the water level of the Ganga in Varanasi was recorded at 63.36 meters on Saturday. The water is rising at a rate of about two centimeters per hour. The commission has expressed the possibility of the water level continuing to rise for the next 48 hours. Water also reaching from MP and Chhattisgarh Along with the water coming from Prayagraj, water from the rivers of Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh is also reaching the Ganga. Its direct effect is visible on the water level of the river in Varanasi. Paths closed on ghats, stairs submerged in water Due to the rising water level, a large part of the stairs at many ghats has been submerged in water. The traditional path from one ghat to another has also been closed at many places. This is causing inconvenience to devotees, local people, and those commuting by boat at the ghats. At many ghats, including Tulsi Ghat, water has reached the stairs. With the rising water level, security has also been increased at the ghats. Cremation space reduced at Manikarnika The effect of the rising water level of the Ganga is also visible at the cremation ground on Manikarnika Ghat. Due to the rising water, the space available for cremation is continuously shrinking. People working at the ghat and relatives arriving with bodies are having to arrange cremations in a limited space. Barricading for the Safety of Kanwariyas Considering Sawan and Kanwar Yatra, the administration has started exercising special vigilance at the ghats. Barricading has been done at several places for the safety of devotees. The activity of the water police has also been increased. Boatmen are being instructed to operate their boats carefully, considering the strong current of the river and the rising water level. The administration is keeping an eye on the activities happening at the ghats and in the river. Intermittent rain expected for 48 to 72 hours Amidst the rising water level of the Ganga, the Meteorological Department has also predicted rain in the coming days. On Saturday, the temperature in Varanasi was around 29 degrees Celsius. The wind speed was recorded at about 11 kilometers per hour and humidity at 84 percent. According to meteorologist Prof. Manoj Srivastava, the monsoon trough has shifted from southern Uttar Pradesh to Bihar, Bengal, and Assam. This may lead to a decrease in rainfall activities in Purvanchal for now. However, there is a possibility of intermittent rain in the next 48 to 72 hours. Relief on Friday after heavy rain on Thursday After the heavy rain on August 6, the pace of rain in Varanasi remained subdued on Friday. Some areas experienced drizzle, but there was no heavy rain. Due to the decrease in rain, the temperature increased by about five degrees. On Friday, Varanasi recorded a maximum temperature of 35 degrees Celsius and a minimum of 27.1 degrees Celsius. Instructions to increase the capacity of flood relief camps After the water level of the Ganga rose, the district administration has also intensified flood relief preparations. On Friday, ADM (Finance) and In-charge Disaster Officer Sadanand Gupta held a virtual meeting with officials from departments related to flood control. In the meeting, relief and rescue preparations were reviewed to deal with the potential flood situation. The ADM instructed the Tehsildars of Rajatalab and Sadar Tehsils to inspect the flood relief camps. He also asked to identify 10 to 20 per cent additional sites beyond the existing capacity, so that affected people can be immediately moved to safe places if needed.

stories.title: Yogi to lead Tricolour march in Gorakhpur on August 10:Walk from Rani Lakshmibai statue to Maharana Pratap statue, spread ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ message
stories.summary: On August 10, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will lead a grand Tiranga Yatra in Gorakhpur, as part of the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign being run on the occasion of Partition Horrors Remembrance Day (August 14) and Independence Day (August 15) in Gorakhpur. CM Yogi will lead a 3-kilometer long Tiranga Yatra on foot, from the statue of Rani Lakshmibai located in the Municipal Corporation premises to the statue of Maharana Pratap located at Railway Station Chowk. During this, he will also appeal to the people of the state to hoist the national flag at their respective homes. The state government has set a target of hoisting the national flag on 5 crore homes this year under the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign. With this objective, Tiranga Yatras are being organized across the state. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will launch the campaign from Lucknow on August 9, on Kakori Train Action Day, while on August 10, he will participate in the Tiranga Yatra in Gorakhpur. Preparations for Tiranga Yatra in final stage Mayor Dr. Manglesh Srivastava informed that the preparations for the Tiranga Yatra by the Municipal Corporation are in their final stage. The yatra will start from the Municipal Corporation premises and reach Railway Station Chowk via Golghar Chauraha, Kali Mandir, and Yatayat Tiraha. The Chief Minister will first garland the statue of Rani Lakshmibai and offer floral tributes to the statue of Maharana Pratap at the conclusion of the yatra. The Chief Minister will walk the entire route carrying the tricolour flag. In view of this approximately 3-kilometre-long foot march, the administration has made extensive security arrangements. Preparations are being made to deploy police forces along the march route and to keep the traffic system smooth. This is the route of the Tiranga Yatra Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign

stories.title: 'System traps youth in a chakravyuh’, says Rahul Gandhi:Addresses students at Prayagraj; Cong claims over 2 lakh registrations
stories.summary: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi is addressing the students at the ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ event in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. In his address Rahul Gandhi said, “India has around 40 crore young people, and this is the country’s biggest strength”. He also said China is often discussed as a major power, but its strength is nothing compared with the potential of India’s youth. Rahul Gandhi arrived at the airport at around 1.30 pm and went straight to Swaraj Bhawan, where he met party leaders. He is accompanied by Priyanka Gandhi’s daughter, Miraya Vadra. Congress leaders claimed that more than 2 lakh students had registered for the event. The historic building was the birthplace of his grandmother and former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. It is now a museum displaying objects linked to the Nehru-Gandhi family and India's freedom movement. Students from 23 districts have been invited. The Congress claims that more than 2 lakh students have registered, but only around 5,000 people have arrived so far. Rahul Gandhi is expected to raise issues including unemployment, the NEET paper leak, irregularities in recruitment exams, and police lathi-charge on students, targeting the government over these concerns. Congress puts up 'No jobs, no throne' posters Congress workers put up posters across Prayagraj ahead of Gandhi's programme. The posters read: “If there are no jobs, the throne will shake.” Uttar Pradesh Congress president Ajay Rai said the government was afraid of Gandhi. “Everyone in the government is afraid of Rahul Gandhi. BJP leaders are nervous because they have done nothing for students or in the national interest,” Rai said. ₹2 crore pandal set up for programme A pandal costing around ₹2 crore has been erected for the event. A VIP lounge has been set up at the rear, along with eight stalls for VIP guests. Tea and drinking water have been arranged for students at the venue. Dinner has also been arranged for some students. Free e-rickshaw services have been made available to help students reach the venue.

stories.title: Atiq Ahmed's youngest son Abaan laid to rest:Ali, Umar and Ahzam shoulder his bier during final journey
stories.summary: Atiq Ahmed's 21-year-old son Abaan has been laid to rest at the Kasari-Masari cemetery in Prayagraj. He was buried beside his father Atiq's grave. His three brothers, Ali, Umar and Ahzam, carried his bier during the final journey. Around 5,000-6,000 people attended the funeral, while more than 1,000 police personnel were deployed around the cemetery for security. Crowd breaks barricades as Abaan's body arrives Ahzam arrived at the cemetery carrying Abaan's body and was visibly emotional. A large crowd followed him and tried to enter the cemetery. When police stopped them, the crowd became unruly and broke through the barricades. At one point, a police officer used the butt of his rifle to push people back. Some youths still tried to enter the cemetery, prompting police to push them back and disperse the crowd. Police later restricted entry to family members and selected relatives. Shaista Parveen does not attend funeral Abaan's mother, Shaista Parveen, did not attend his funeral. She had also been absent from the funerals of her husband Atiq Ahmed and son Asad. Shaista has been absconding since 2023. Abaan died in a road accident in Jhansi on Thursday. He was travelling from Prayagraj to meet his brother Ali, who is lodged in Jhansi Jail. The Kasari-Masari cemetery, where Abaan was buried, also contains the graves of his grandfather Firoz Ahmed, uncle Ashraf and brother Asad. Ali and Umar attend funeral on parole Ali and Umar reached Prayagraj from Jhansi and Lucknow jails respectively after being granted parole by the Allahabad High Court. Police kept both brothers inside their vans until the final stage of the funeral. When they were brought out, Ali and Umar hugged each other before going to the mosque to offer prayers. They then joined the funeral and helped bury Abaan. Police allowed only family members and relatives to enter the cemetery during the burial. Ali and Umar meet family before returning to jail Ali and Umar are now meeting their family members at a mosque a short distance from the cemetery. The High Court had allowed the brothers to meet only their brother Ahzam and aunt as part of their parole conditions. Police have arranged the meeting outside the mosque, where a tent has been put up. The meeting will last for one hour. After that, police will take Ali back to Jhansi Jail and Umar to Lucknow Jail. This is the first time in four years that Ali and Umar have been granted parole. To know the latest update…please go through the live blog…

The reservation system in the elections will be determined by the report of the Backward Classes Commission formed for reservation in panchayat elections. The report will take time to arrive. Meanwhile, political experts cite 3 reasons for this 1. Risk of loss for BJP in assembly elections 2. Risk of split in BJP alliance 3. stories.title: Atiq’s son Ali says, ‘My brother has left me too’:'Haven't slept or eaten for two nights in Jhansi jail'
stories.summary: 'I am coming to meet; I got a bit late.' These 10 words belong to mafia Atiq Ahmed's younger son Abaan, which he said to a police inspector on the phone before reaching Jhansi jail. Just a few minutes later, Abaan died. Abaan was going to meet his brother Ali Ahmed, who is imprisoned in Jhansi jail, on Thursday. On the highway, while trying to save an animal, the car hit the divider. In the accident, Abaan and his friend Sonu died, while three friends were injured. When Ali received the news of his brother's death, he broke down crying. He said, 'Now my brother has also left me.' He kept tossing and turning all night. Kept crying. On normal days, Ali used to exercise in the morning. He also used to talk to some people. But, due to the shock, he remained confined inside his cell. He kept asking the jail officials who came every hour for security checks about the accident repeatedly. Jail sources said that on Friday morning he only had a light breakfast. After that, he did not come out even to eat food. Abaan used to come to Jhansi Jail almost every week to meet Ali loved his younger brother Abaan with all his heart. Abaan also loved him. He used to meet him about three to four times every month. During the meetings, LIU and constables were also present. Sources say that as soon as Ali and Abaan saw each other, they would embrace. They would meet like this for a few minutes. Their meetings took place under strict surveillance. For the purpose of meetings, Abaan would often stay at a hotel near the bus stand. On every visit, Abaan would bring novels and books for his elder brother to read. After the accident on Thursday, two books were found in the car - 'The Stationery Shop of Tehran' and 'The Idiot'. Ali told High Court Judge - Let me go to the funeral The family of Ali, imprisoned in Jhansi jail, and Umar, imprisoned in Lucknow jail, had filed a petition for parole in the High Court to attend Abaan's funeral. During the hearing on Friday, both were connected to the court via video conferencing. They said they wanted to attend their brother's funeral. Both assured the court that they will not speak to the media, will not post anything on social media, will not address any gathering, and will not participate in any other event. The court asked for strict compliance with these conditions. The High Court ordered that Ali and Umar be taken directly from jail to Kasari-Masari cemetery. There they have been permitted to meet their younger brother Ahzam and aunt Parveen Qureshi for one hour. This meeting will be under police supervision. After this, both will be sent back to jail. The court has also directed the state government and DGP to ensure the security and necessary arrangements for both. Jhansi jail administration wrote a letter to SSP to take Ali Atiq's sister Parveen Qureshi had filed a petition in the High Court for parole of Umar and Ali. Their advocate Mohammad Safdar Ali Kazmi presented this matter in court. The bench of Justice Ajay Bhanot and DC Samant ordered parole. Now the Jhansi jail administration has written a letter to the SSP to take Ali to Prayagraj under police security by providing a police guard. Abaan was going to meet his brother in jail, died in a road accident

stories.title: ‘BJP MLA will get both of us killed’:Former block chief reaches SP office in Sultanpur, alleges murder plot
stories.summary: Monu, brother of former MLA Sonu Singh, has accused BJP MLA Vinod Singh from Sultanpur of conspiracy to murder. Former Block Head Yashbhadra Singh (Monu) met the SP on Monday afternoon at 2:30 PM and gave him a written complaint against Vinod Singh. Monu Singh stated that an audio surfaced on August 6 through social media. In it, MLA Vinod Singh is talking to a woman. He can be heard talking about getting me and my brother Sonu Singh murdered. The BJP MLA can get both of us brothers murdered at any time. Read the allegations made by the former Block Pramukh against the BJP MLA Handed over a pen drive to the SP, said - get the audio investigated Yashbhadra Singh (Monu) handed over a pen drive containing the recording of the viral audio along with a written complaint to the SP. He demanded that the voice and authenticity of the audio be investigated by a forensic science laboratory. Also, a case of conspiracy to murder should be registered against MLA Vinod Singh and legal action should be taken. 'Both of us brothers were attacked in Prayagraj-Ayodhya court' Monu Singh, referring to the deadly attack in Prayagraj Court, stated that policemen, advocates, and petitioners sustained serious injuries in it. Additionally, on July 9, 2024, many people were injured in an attack on both of us at the Ayodhya Court premises. MLA Vinod Singh is also a named accused in this case. Monu Singh responded to the claim of AI audio Regarding the authenticity of the viral audio and the woman's allegations, Monu Singh said- Information about this can be obtained from the parties involved or former professors of KNIT. Regarding claims that the audio is AI-generated, he said that the concerned person can provide their voice sample for forensic examination. Now, read what's in the viral audio The viral audio claims a conversation with a woman in the name of the MLA. It can be heard that Sonu-Monu are from Sultanpur. Enmity was taken with them because they could commit murder. After this, there is also alleged talk of getting both of them murdered. It can be heard in the audio that first, their attack was awaited. After that, there was talk of eliminating them. Additionally, it is claimed that both brothers were confined to their home and not allowed to go out. In the viral audio, it is also mentioned in the name of the MLA that the sources of Sonu-Monu's contracting, land purchase, and taking crores of rupees from the block have been stopped. It is also being claimed that three kilns of Sonu-Monu have been shut down. Now both brothers have no source of income left.

stories.title: Father swept away in canal while returning with daughter:Fell after hitting bridge, body found 20m away by SDRF 2 hours later
stories.summary: A father died after drowning in a canal in Lucknow on Monday. He was returning home with his daughter from school on a bike. Near the DRM office, a truck suddenly appeared from the front. This caused the bike to go out of control and hit the culvert. The father was thrown into the canal, while the daughter fell on the road. The father was swept away in the canal. SDRF, which arrived about 2 hours after the information, recovered the father's body. The deceased was identified as Ravi Kushwaha (41), a resident of Khushi Vihar, Krishnanagar. He was an LIC agent. He is survived by his wife Sunita Kushwaha and 2 children. His daughter Vanshika (8) studies at Avadh Collegiate School. Ravi was returning with her. Vanshika sustained minor injuries. Enraged by the incident, the corporators sat on a protest. The incident occurred at 11 AM in the Manaknagar police station area. 3 pictures after the accident Balance lost due to truck coming from opposite direction According to eyewitnesses, Ravi was turning his bike. Meanwhile, a truck suddenly appeared from the front. This startled him and he lost control of the bike. It is being said that during this time, Ravi pressed the accelerator along with the brake, due to which the bike sped forward. It collided with the broken stone section near the culvert. The impact was so strong that Ravi was thrown and fell into the branch canal of Sharda Canal. He tried hard to get out, moving his hands and feet. But, he drowned in the 6-feet deep canal due to the strong current. His daughter Vanshika said that a truck was coming on the service lane from the opposite direction. Seeing it, Dad suddenly applied the front brake. This caused the bike to slip and hit the stone of the culvert. Dad went straight into the canal. I remained on the road with the bike. Police said - We don't have divers After the accident, people present at the spot informed the police on 112. It is alleged that the police who arrived at the scene said they did not have divers. Additionally, they stated that the incident site belonged to another police station. At this, the local people became angry. Later, the Alambagh police station in-charge and other policemen, accompanied by the Manaknagar police station police, arrived at the spot. They informed the SDRF. Around 1 PM, the SDRF team began searching for Ravi in the canal. Police investigating how he fell into the canal During the SDRF search, Ravi was found about 20 meters away from the accident site in the canal. His body was stuck in the bushes. Police sent the body to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Police sent the body for post-mortem and started investigating the matter. Maanak Nagar Police Station in-charge Ajit Kumar said that the police reached the spot on time after receiving the information. SDRF was immediately called. After that, a rescue operation was launched and the body was recovered. An investigation is underway into how he fell into the canal. Enraged people sat on a dharna Enraged by the incident, people and Kesari Kheda ward councilor Devendra Singh Jeetu sat on a dharna on the road for half an hour. Tehsildar, DRM's PRO and Manak Nagar's Inspector reached the spot. The dharna was ended after convincing the councilor and local people. During this, traffic was affected.

stories.title: Youth thrown off from stage in front of Pawan Singh:Brought his mother’s photo; powerstar called him back and took a photo with him
stories.summary: The crowd became uncontrollable to catch a glimpse of Bhojpuri singer and star Pawan Singh at the Kanwar Mahotsav in Basti, UP, on Sunday night. Many people crossed the barricades. Security personnel took charge and calmed the crowd. During this, a young man climbed onto the stage. Security personnel picked him up and threw him off the stage. Seeing this, Pawan Singh could not stop himself. He called the young man to him and also took a photo. The young man had a picture of Pawan Singh and his mother in his hand. The young man gifted the picture to Pawan Singh. Bhojpuri singer Kalpana Patwari was also present at this event. She sang songs like 'Ganesh Ke Papa Humse E Bhang Pisai Na' and 'Naach Kanwariya Shiv Ke Nagariya'. Around one and a half lakh Kanwariyas and spectators danced enthusiastically to her songs. Fellow artists also entertained the people. See 4 pictures Pawan Singh reached the stage at 9:20 PM Pawan Singh arrived on stage around 9:20 PM on Sunday night. Seeing him, the entire marquee erupted in applause. The Kanwariyas and organizers gave him a grand welcome. Pawan Singh sang several songs related to Sawan and devotion to Lord Shiva. He sang songs like 'Barse Sawan Ke Pani, Chuata To Bhigat Bani', 'Dum Dum Damru Bajavele Hamar Jogiya', and 'Ganga Nahail Bahut Baat Naikhe, Kanwar Uthawal Bahut Baat Hola'. The audience's enthusiasm grew so much that people started moving forward. Under the pressure of the crowd, the barriers broke. For some time, a chaotic situation arose at the event venue. After the barrier broke, police personnel present at the scene immediately began controlling the crowd. The police pushed people back and took charge of security arrangements around the stage. After the situation was brought under control, Pawan Singh's performance continued. MP Jagdambika Pal, former MP Dhananjay Singh had arrived Many people were present at the Kanwar festival, including former MP Dhananjay Singh, Siddharthnagar MP Jagdambika Pal, former IAS O.N. Singh, former Cabinet Minister Raj Kishore Singh, and BJP leader Ankur Verma. At the Bhandara, former MP Dhananjay Singh distributed Prasad to the devotees of Shiva. People showed great enthusiasm to meet him and get pictures taken with him. This program was organized by Maa Shanti Seva Sansthan. Approximately one and a half lakh people attended this event, which took place near Futhia Flyover on the Basti-Ayodhya Fourlane. The program was inaugurated by the organizer Tej Pratap Singh 'Suddu' and his wife Shimpy Singh, who performed a ritualistic worship of Lord Shiva amidst Vedic chants.
